system_requirements.hard_requirement: "Your CPU must support the AVX2 instruction set. This is the one hard requirement AnythingLLM has of your hardware." The default vector database, LanceDB, compiles against an Intel Haswell (2013) baseline; on a CPU without AVX2 the upstream text says the server "is killed the moment LanceDB loads and the container exits" with an Illegal instruction from the entrypoint's line 7. Check inside the guest: `lscpu | grep -o avx2`. The documented escape is to move off LanceDB by setting VECTOR_DB - an operator decision, not a manifest line, so this file names the check and conformance.md carries it as a pre-flight.
system_requirements.against_q33: The standard composition can enable chat; the foundation baseline is 16 GB.

that the container boots with read_only: true. The entrypoint runs `npx prisma generate` from /app/server, which regenerates a client into the image root; whether the pinned build's already-generated client makes that a no-op is unknown, and if it is not a no-op the first boot fails with EROFS. conformance.md row 3 is the check and CONTRACT.md names the two remedies; neither has been applied.

that /app/collector writes nothing outside the paths this manifest makes writable. The entrypoint always starts the collector; its hotdir/outputs are bind-mounted in upstream's own compose and are tmpfs here.
